claims.statement: API reference for LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, and integrations is generated and deployed outside this repository at separate Python (reference.langchain.com/python/) and JavaScript/TypeScript (reference.langchain.com/javascript/) sites, not built as part of the docs.langchain.com pipeline.

Documentation authors write semantic cross-references using @[ClassName] syntax in markdown; these are resolved at build time via SCOPE_LINK_MAPS (python and js scopes) to URLs on reference.langchain.com, supporting both @[link_name] and @[Custom Title][link_name] formats with optional backticks.

SCOPE_LINK_MAPS maps symbol names (e.g., StateGraph, ChatOpenAI, @traceable) to reference.langchain.com paths for each language scope; if a cross-reference is not found in the scope map, an info-level warning is logged and the reference appears unchanged as literal text.

Three OpenAPI specifications power LangSmith API documentation sections: Agent Server API (committed at src/langsmith/agent-server-openapi.json, updated via langgraph-api PRs), Control Plane API (fetched at deploy time from https://api.host.langchain.com/openapi.json, no local file), and LangSmith REST API (committed at src/langsmith/langsmith-platform-openapi.json, refreshed daily via GitHub Actions).

src/langsmith/agent-server-openapi.json is updated by PRs from the langgraph-api repository titled 'Update Agent ServerOpenAPI spec for API version X.Y.Z'; make check-openapi builds the documentation and validates that Agent Server specification only.

src/langsmith/langsmith-platform-openapi.json is refreshed daily by .github/workflows/refresh-langsmith-openapi.yml, which runs scripts/process_langsmith_openapi.py and opens or appends to a standing chore/refresh-langsmith-openapi PR; the file must not be edited by hand.

Issues with reference.langchain.com content (missing pages, broken links, incorrect type signatures) are reported via a dedicated issue template that routes to reference docs maintainers; fixes happen in the reference generation tooling, not in this repository.

The Markdown preprocessor applies autolink replacement before conditional rendering, tracks scope from :::python and :::js fences, skips ordinary fenced code blocks, and preserves backslash-escaped autolinks as literal text; its unhandled global scope falls back to Python and logs an error.

make check-cross-refs scans Markdown and MDX under src with the shared autolink patterns, ignores code-sample snippets and node_modules, and fails when a reference is absent from every scope in which the authored file will be built; shared oss files are checked against both Python and JavaScript maps.

The docs.json navigation config connects the committed Agent Server and LangSmith REST specs to the langsmith/agent-server-api and langsmith/smith-api generated directories, while configuring the Control Plane API from its remote URL.
make check-openapi builds documentation and runs Mintlify openapi-check only for langsmith/agent-server-openapi.json in build, and the CI link-check workflow invokes that target.

The LangSmith OpenAPI refresh workflow runs daily at 10:00 UTC and manually on demand, regenerates the committed spec, reuses an open chore/refresh-langsmith-openapi PR when available, and makes no commit when the generated file is unchanged.

scripts/process_langsmith_openapi.py fetches the LangSmith spec only from allow-listed api.smith.langchain.com with a 30-second timeout, and post-processes it for public Mintlify documentation by hiding fleet/internal/health operations, grouping tags, and normalizing operation titles including visible v2 labels.

The broken-link targets filter Mintlify reports after building: the filter excludes all three OpenAPI-generated destinations, standalone snippet sections, and selected legacy false positives; anchor mode additionally excludes only three named SmithDB migration anchors and the exact /langsmith/env-var-cloud#n_jobs_per_worker anchor, while remaining indented link reports fail the command.

Focused cross-reference checker tests cover Python and JavaScript scope selection, shared-file validation, unresolved/custom-title/backtick/multiple references, and the code-block, escaped-reference, and code-sample exclusions; broken-link filter tests assert that genuine failures and non-exempt anchors remain after filtering, including the exact env-var anchor exemption.
The LangSmith OpenAPI processor supports controlled local input through --input, writes its transformed output only with --write, and otherwise prints the transformed JSON to standard output.
The reference-documentation issue template requires an issue type, language, and detailed description, and collects a product and optional reference-page URL for routing reports.
LangSmith OpenAPI title normalization removes prior trailing Beta and v2 markers before applying normalized markers, so repeated processing is idempotent.

The docs.json navigation keeps authored overview pages with each generated section: Agent Server and Control Plane API are in the LangSmith deployment Reference group, and the LangSmith REST API overview is in the product Reference tab alongside its OpenAPI declaration.

Mintlify generates the Agent Server, Control Plane, and LangSmith REST endpoint pages from the OpenAPI declarations in src/docs.json at deployment; those endpoint pages are not repository-authored Markdown or MDX sources.
The LangSmith OpenAPI processor accepts an optional --output path, but it writes the transformed document only when --write is set; without that flag, it prints JSON to standard output.

packages.yml documents package metadata such as repository, package path, integration visibility, JavaScript package, provider page, download, and has_reference_docs fields; has_reference_docs is the opt-in for third-party packages whose reference documentation is hosted on reference.langchain.com, otherwise the package destination falls back to PyPI.

pipeline/tools/partner_pkg_table.py selects reference destinations from package metadata: monorepo and langchain-ai packages use reference.langchain.com, eligible third-party packages require has_reference_docs, and otherwise package_url falls back to PyPI; integration links use the canonical top-level /python/<package> path.
The provider integration overview is generated by pipeline/tools/partner_pkg_table.py from packages.yml, and CI regenerates it rather than accepting hand-edited generated output.
